name: ldo_3v3
summary: AMS1117-3.3 linear regulator (SOT-223) with the 22 uF solid tantalum output capacitor its datasheet asks for.

sources.document: AMS1117 datasheet (ds1117.pdf): absolute maximum ratings, input voltage 15 V; AMS1117-3.3 output 3.300 V typ at VIN 4.8 V
AMS1117 datasheet (ds1117.pdf): dropout 1.3 V max at IOUT 0.8 A; dropout is specified up to 0.8 A only (note 4)
AMS1117 datasheet (ds1117.pdf): quiescent current 11 mA max at (VIN - VOUT) = 1.5 V
AMS1117 datasheet (ds1117.pdf), Stability: 22 uF solid tantalum on the output ensures stability for all operating conditions
Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, section 1.3.2 Power Supply

ports.name: vin
ports.note: minimum = 3.3 V output + 1.3 V maximum dropout at 0.8 A (page 3); maximum = 15 V absolute maximum input (page 2)

ports.name: vout
ports.note: 0.8 A: the dropout is specified up to 0.8 A only (the datasheet's headline output current is 1 A)

notes.text: Output capacitor: 22 uF solid tantalum, as the datasheet asks for stability; a ceramic capacitor is not substituted.
The datasheet gives no input capacitor value. The power-input blocks carry the 10 uF Espressif recommends at the power entrance.
Dropout is specified up to 0.8 A only; from a USB 5 V source (4.0 V at 3 A in the conservative range) the input can fall below the 4.6 V this block needs.
Dissipation (V_in - 3.3 V) x I_load must be checked against the SOT-223 package; the composer computes it (formula 'dissipation').
